description: Move a payment to a new due date, and optionally change the months it covers. startDate and endDate cover whole months; when only one is supplied, the existing other bound is reused. paymentId accepts a full UUID or a unique prefix of one in this building.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

endDate.description: New coverage end; normalized to the last day of its month.

paymentId.description: UUID of the payment, or a unique prefix of one in this building.

startDate.description: New coverage start; normalized to the first day of its month. When only one bound is supplied, the existing other bound is reused.

name: reschedule_payment
title: Reschedule payment
